_note: Las claves siguen la convención establecida en el proyecto (namespace implícito por componente).

CostOfInactionChart.title.message: The cost of inaction: resilience CAPEX vs VoLL exposure (2025–2030)

CostOfInactionChart.subtitle.message: Comparison between accumulated investment in resilience infrastructure and the expected economic exposure if the current low-grid-strength architecture is maintained. When the VoLL curve exceeds the CAPEX curve, inaction is more expensive than investment. Values beyond 2026 are projections. Select a deployment scenario.

CostOfInactionChart.scenarioLabel.description: Label for scenario selector in CostOfInactionChart

CostOfInactionChart.crossingLabel.description: Label shown at the CAPEX/VoLL crossing point

CostOfInactionChart.reading.base.message: CAPEX disbursement following the PERTE ERHA schedule. The indifference point between investing and not investing falls in 2027: from that year, cumulative VoLL exposure exceeds total committed CAPEX. The Operational Reinforcement would cost over 6,600 M€ accumulated by 2030.
CostOfInactionChart.reading.base.description: Reading card text for base scenario

CostOfInactionChart.reading.acelerado.message: If CAPEX is brought forward one year through fiscal incentives, the cumulative VoLL exposure never exceeds the cost of investment within the 2030 horizon. The effective payback period falls to 2.4 years.
CostOfInactionChart.reading.acelerado.description: Reading card text for accelerated scenario

CostOfInactionChart.reading.retrasado.message: Regulatory paralysis deferring CAPEX to 2027 causes projected VoLL exposure to exceed 8,000 M€ by 2030 — more than double the required CAPEX. Each year of delay adds approximately 820 M€ in structural overrun.
CostOfInactionChart.reading.retrasado.description: Reading card text for delayed scenario

CostOfInactionChart.methodNote.message: ⚠ Values beyond 2026 are projections. CAPEX: 3,010 M€ BESS+SynCons + 650 M€ P.O.7.4 retrofit (Engie-Rolwind; CNMC). Projected OR: 1,200 M€/year on real REE data (666 M€ to Mar-2026). VoLL: ACER/CEER methodology, probability of systemic event × expected ENS under weak architecture (ERAA post-28A).

ReserveMarginDegradationFigure.title.message: IBR penetration and escalation of adjustment costs (2020–2025)

ReserveMarginDegradationFigure.subtitle.message: As asynchronous generation displaced synchronous mass from the mix, technical restriction and adjustment service costs escalated non-linearly. The 2025 Operational Reinforcement is the visible consequence of this structural accumulation. Click each year to expand.

ReserveMarginDegradationFigure.annotOR.description: Annotation label for OR year in chart

ReserveMarginDegradationFigure.methodNot.message: ⚠ IBR penetration: fraction of peninsular generation provided by technologies without direct synchronous coupling (PV, full-converter wind, inverter-based storage). Restriction and adjustment service costs: REE/ESIOS published settlements. The 2025 figure includes the Operational Reinforcement surcharge (May–Dec 2025; REE official note Apr 2026).
